units.text: The signing of the U.S. Constitution occurred inside Independence Hall’s Assembly Room on September 17, 1787, with no recorded outdoor spectators.

citations.title: Signing of the United States Constitution - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: The passage supports the date and Independence Hall location, but does not mention the Assembly Room or anything about outdoor spectators.

units.text: Three hundred ninety delegates signed the Constitution on September 17, 1787, at Independence Hall in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

citations.title: Signing of the United States Constitution - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: The passage states 39 delegates endorsed the Constitution, not three hundred ninety (390).

units.text: The claim states spectators watched outside Independence Hall, but the record describes an internal signing by delegates.

judgement.reason: The passages support that delegates signed the Constitution inside Independence Hall, but they do not mention spectators watching outside or the purported claim about them.
